Name: Resource Tracker
Author: Pasca1409
Description:
This mod allows you to pin crafting recipes, cooking recipes, Robin's buildings, and shop upgrades directly to your screen. It automatically scans all your chests across your entire farm and calculates exactly what you have and what you still need to gather.
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/b].[/*]
[*][i](Optional, but highly recommended)[/i] Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b] to easily adjust the mod settings and hotkeys in-game.[/*]
[*]Download the "Resource Tracker" archive and extract it.[/*]
[*]Move the extracted folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]How to Use[/b]
[list]
[*]Open any Crafting menu, Robin's Carpenter menu, or Clint's Shop.[/*]
[*]Hover your mouse over the item or building you want to track.[/*]
[*]Press [b]I[/b] (default) to pin the item to your screen. Press [b]U[/b] to decrease the amount.[/*]
[*][b]Pro Tip:[/b] Hold your [b]Modifier Key[/b] (Default: [b]Alt [/b]) while pressing I or U to add/remove [b]10 items at once[/b]![/*]
[*]Press [b]J[/b] (default) to toggle the detailed summary list on and off.[/*]
[*]To quickly remove an item from your tracker, simply [b]Right-Click[/b] its icon on your screen.[/*]
[/list][b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Universal Tracking:[/b] Works seamlessly with standard Crafting, Cooking, Robin's Buildings, and Shop/Tool upgrades (like Clint's pickaxe).[/*]
[*][b]Global Chest Scanning:[/b] The mod silently scans your backpack, all chests (on the farm, inside sheds, inside cabins), and your fridges (including Ginger Island). You will always know exactly how many resources you own globally.[/*]
[*][b]Smart UI Feedback:[/b] The detailed summary shows you exactly where your items are formatted as
[code]Total Amount (Amount in Chests) / Required[/code]Text turns beautifully [b]green[/b] when you have collected enough materials and gold.[/*]
[*][b]Persistent Tracking:[/b] Pinned tasks are saved to your save file. You can close the game and pick up your farming projects right where you left off the next day.[/*]
[*][b]Fully configurable:[/b] Using the [i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i], you can easily adjust all hotkeys, the maximum amount of rows the UI should take up, and toggle the text-list visibility directly in the game.[/*]
[*][b]Translation ready:[/b] The mod uses i18n files and can easily be translated into different languages.[/*]
[/list][b]Supported Languages[/b]
Currently, the mod includes translations for:
[list]
[*]English[/*]
[*]German[/*]
[/list]
